3pub(super) fn brainstorm(
4    env: &mut GameEnv,
5    controller: u8,
6    source_id: CardId,
7    payload: &EffectPayload,
8    reveal_count: u8,
9    per_climax: u8,
10    mode: crate::db::BrainstormMode,
11) {
12    let mut climax_hits: u32 = 0;
13    for _ in 0..reveal_count {
14        let Some(card) = env.draw_from_deck(controller) else {
15            break;
16        };
17        let is_climax = env
18            .db
19            .get(card.id)
20            .map(|c| c.card_type == CardType::Climax)
21            .unwrap_or(false);
22        env.reveal_card(
23            controller,
24            &card,
25            RevealReason::AbilityEffect,
26            RevealAudience::Public,
27        );
28        env.move_card_between_zones(controller, card, Zone::Deck, Zone::WaitingRoom, None, None);
29        if is_climax {
30            climax_hits = climax_hits.saturating_add(1);
31        }
32    }
33    let total = climax_hits.saturating_mul(per_climax as u32);
34    if total == 0 {
35        return;
36    }
37    match mode {
38        crate::db::BrainstormMode::Draw => {
39            let spec = EffectSpec {
40                id: payload.spec.id,
41                kind: EffectKind::BrainstormDrawChoice,
42                target: None,
43                optional: false,
44            };
45            for _ in 0..total {
46                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, spec.clone());
47            }
48        }
49        crate::db::BrainstormMode::SalvageCharacter => {
50            let spec = EffectSpec {
51                id: payload.spec.id,
52                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
53                target: Some(TargetSpec {
54                    zone: TargetZone::WaitingRoom,
55                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
56                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
57                    card_type: Some(CardType::Character),
58                    card_trait: None,
59                    level_max: None,
60                    cost_max: None,
61                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
62                    count: 1,
63                    limit: None,
64                    source_only: false,
65                    reveal_to_controller: false,
66                }),
67                optional: true,
68            };
69            for _ in 0..total {
70                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, spec.clone());
71            }
72        }
73        crate::db::BrainstormMode::LookTopToHand => {
74            let spec = EffectSpec {
75                id: payload.spec.id,
76                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
77                target: Some(TargetSpec {
78                    zone: TargetZone::DeckTop,
79                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
80                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
81                    card_type: None,
82                    card_trait: None,
83                    level_max: None,
84                    cost_max: None,
85                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
86                    count: 1,
87                    limit: Some(3),
88                    source_only: false,
89                    reveal_to_controller: false,
90                }),
91                optional: true,
92            };
93            for _ in 0..total {
94                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, spec.clone());
95            }
96        }
97        crate::db::BrainstormMode::LookTopToHandThenDiscard => {
98            let look_spec = EffectSpec {
99                id: payload.spec.id,
100                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
101                target: Some(TargetSpec {
102                    zone: TargetZone::DeckTop,
103                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
104                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
105                    card_type: None,
106                    card_trait: None,
107                    level_max: None,
108                    cost_max: None,
109                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
110                    count: 1,
111                    limit: Some(3),
112                    source_only: false,
113                    reveal_to_controller: false,
114                }),
115                optional: true,
116            };
117            let discard_spec = EffectSpec {
118                id: payload.spec.id,
119                kind: EffectKind::MoveToWaitingRoom,
120                target: Some(TargetSpec {
121                    zone: TargetZone::Hand,
122                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
123                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
124                    card_type: None,
125                    card_trait: None,
126                    level_max: None,
127                    cost_max: None,
128                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
129                    count: 1,
130                    limit: None,
131                    source_only: false,
132                    reveal_to_controller: false,
133                }),
134                optional: false,
135            };
136            for _ in 0..total {
137                // Enqueue discard first so look-to-hand resolves before discard.
138                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, discard_spec.clone());
139                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, look_spec.clone());
140            }
141        }
142        crate::db::BrainstormMode::SalvageCharacterThenDiscard => {
143            let salvage_spec = EffectSpec {
144                id: payload.spec.id,
145                kind: EffectKind::MoveToHand,
146                target: Some(TargetSpec {
147                    zone: TargetZone::WaitingRoom,
148                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
149                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
150                    card_type: Some(CardType::Character),
151                    card_trait: None,
152                    level_max: None,
153                    cost_max: None,
154                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
155                    count: 1,
156                    limit: None,
157                    source_only: false,
158                    reveal_to_controller: false,
159                }),
160                optional: true,
161            };
162            let discard_spec = EffectSpec {
163                id: payload.spec.id,
164                kind: EffectKind::MoveToWaitingRoom,
165                target: Some(TargetSpec {
166                    zone: TargetZone::Hand,
167                    side: TargetSide::SelfSide,
168                    slot_filter: TargetSlotFilter::Any,
169                    card_type: None,
170                    card_trait: None,
171                    level_max: None,
172                    cost_max: None,
173                    card_ids: Vec::new(),
174                    count: 1,
175                    limit: None,
176                    source_only: false,
177                    reveal_to_controller: false,
178                }),
179                optional: false,
180            };
181            for _ in 0..total {
182                // Enqueue discard first so salvage resolves before discard.
183                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, discard_spec.clone());
184                env.enqueue_effect_spec(controller, source_id, salvage_spec.clone());
185            }
186        }
187    }
188}

190pub(super) fn brainstorm_draw_choice(env: &mut GameEnv, controller: u8) {
191    env.scratch.choice_options.clear();
192    env.scratch.choice_options.push(ChoiceOptionRef {
193        card_id: 0,
194        instance_id: 0,
195        zone: ChoiceZone::DeckTop,
196        index: Some(0),
197        target_slot: None,
198    });
199    env.scratch.choice_options.push(ChoiceOptionRef {
200        card_id: 0,
201        instance_id: 0,
202        zone: ChoiceZone::Skip,
203        index: Some(1),
204        target_slot: None,
205    });
206    let options = std::mem::take(&mut env.scratch.choice_options);
207    let _ = env.start_choice(
208        ChoiceReason::BrainstormDrawSelect,
209        controller,
210        options,
211        None,
212    );
213}
